none: PAS CAM-E3E9D2: Roman Coin : Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint is uncertain, c.330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse shows bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse shows two soldiers, two standards. Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse field and exergue reads: / //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 0.60g, diameter is 14mm
